items.title: Ravencoin, a blockchain built from Bitcoin’s code, could roll back four days of transactions
items.summary: Two mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hashpower are building a replacement chain from before Friday’s first invalid block, putting deposits, withdrawals and payments made since then at risk of reversal.

items.title: Luke Dashjr removed as Bitcoin Improvement Proposal editor
items.summary: Luke Dashjr lost his BIP editor privileges after developers raised concerns over his role in BIP 110 and its stalled minority fork.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin at $63,600 as Japan's Metaplanet moves 3,881 BTC between wallets
items.summary: Blockchain data shows the Japanese treasury firm moved the bitcoin between wallets it controls, not to an exchange, so the transfer isn't a sale despite its $1.4 billion paper loss.

items.summary: The exchange is joining a tokenized stock market that has grown 600% in a year, though its products offer price exposure rather than share ownership.

items.summary: Bitcoin and ether are stuck in a tight range ahead of the CPI. Here’s how savvy traders are positioning for the pivotal release.

items.summary: Harmony said in Asian morning hours it is working with exchanges to freeze funds and preparing a software fix.

items.title: Dogecoin and BNB lead majors higher as bitcoin slips near $63,700
items.summary: DOGE gained almost 3% to 7 cents and BNB 2% to $614, while bitcoin was the only major in the red on both the day and the week.

items.title: XRP bridge drained for $200,000 after software mistook fake deposits for real ones
items.summary: An attacker created unbacked XRP on another blockchain, then exchanged it for real XRP held in reserve. The bridge has been halted and its operator has filed a complaint with the FBI.

items.title: SEC, CFTC sue Goliath Ventures over $400M crypto Ponzi scheme
items.summary: Regulators allege Goliath promised crypto liquidity-pool returns but instead paid earlier investors and funded its founder’s luxury spending.

items.summary: Weeks of sideways trading have crushed volatility, leaving Wednesday’s inflation report as the next potential catalyst, analysts said.

items.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
items.summary: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.
